1879060346.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War
1879060346.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879060986.name: Trick: Disable
1879060986.desc: Strike to slow the foe's attacks.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

1879062906.name: Track Wood
1879062906.desc: When active, nearby tree branches are displayed on the radar.

1879064186.name: Dissonant Strike
1879064186.desc: A damaging melee attack that increases the potency of incoming healing.

1879073530.name: Duty-bound
1879073530.desc: You provide a bonus to your Fellowship's Morale.

1879102586.name: Second Wind
1879102586.desc: Consumes all current fervour and restores power. Amount of power restored is based off the amount of fervour consumed.

1879131130.name: Wall of Steel
1879131130.desc: A weaving pattern of weapon attacks, dealing strong direct damage.

1879145594.name: Guide to the Twenty-first Hall
1879145594.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Twenty-first Hall in Moria.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879182842.name: Improved Rune-sign of Flame
1879182842.desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Fire
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with elemental powers.

1879185146.name: Pale Golden Summer Pony
1879185146.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879198330.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Onyx Lynx)
1879198330.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879212922.name: Trick: Improved Counter Defence
1879212922.desc: Strike to lower the enemy's defences.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

1879214586.name: Wall of Steel
1879214586.desc: A weaving pattern of weapon attacks, dealing strong direct damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879219450.name: Improved Rousing Words
1879219450.desc:
A channelled skill that heals Morale with every second.

+2 to Healing attunement.

This skill generates no threat.

1879221498.name: Autumnfest Pony
1879221498.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879240698.name: Recuperate
1879240698.desc: A Champion knows when they must leave the din of battle for brief respite, relying on their War-steed for safety.

1879248378.name: Seeking Arrow - Fire
1879248378.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Fire-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879272826.name: Improved Sure Strike
1879272826.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.\n\nReduces the active cooldown of Battle-shout.

1879274106.name: Snap Shot - Improved Hampering Javelin of Fire
1879274106.desc: A precise throw can pin a target to the ground and hinder its movement for a short while thereafter.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879301242.name: Muster in Aldburg
1879301242.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Aldburg in western Rohan.

1879312762.name: White Swan
1879312762.desc: Summons a white swan to brighten your day.

1879319930.name: Ride for Ruin
1879319930.desc: You ride for ruin and for victory, greatly increasing your chance to land a critical hit.

1879320186.name: Expose (Man, Dual)
1879320186.desc: Seeing a weakness in the enemy's defences, you exploit it, increasing your target's vulnerability to damage.\n\nMakes targets more vulnerable to Tactical damage in Man form.

1879341434.name: Winter's Flower
1879341434.desc: Brings out a winter's flower for you to fly!

1879342074.name: Guide to the Camp of the Host
1879342074.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Camp of the Host.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879386106.name: Goat of Ered Mithrin
1879386106.desc: A goat inspired by the stalwart beauty of the Grey Mountains.

1879389050.name: Big Blue Carpenter Bee
1879389050.desc: Brings out a big blue carpenter bee to keep you company.

1879449850.name: Armour Crush (Dual)
1879449850.desc: You strike your opponent across the face with your paw, increasing the damage they take for a duration.

1879450106.name: Call of Oromë - Melody
1879450106.desc: Requires Melody Stance.\n\nDeals AoE Light damage and significantly reduces Light damage resistance.

1879452410.name: Brutal Swipe
1879452410.desc: You swipe at the target quickly. This attack cannot be evaded.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879458170.name: Frost-tusk Youngling
1879458170.desc: Summons a very small frost-tusk to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467258.name: Thrum of the Sea
1879467258.desc: The low thrum of the sea resonates about the ears of your target, pushing and pulling their mind and holding them in a trance-like state.

1879470586.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879470586.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn discipline allows the Mariner to make his actions more subtle and more dangerous as targets are chosen carefully and with purpose.

1879491066.name: Sapphire Drakeling
1879491066.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879491578.name: Call to the Valar
1879491578.desc: You call upon the wisdom of the Valar, recovering some of your skills and providing a temporary immunity to induction set back from damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Master of Nature's Fury:</rgb> Sticky Gourd, Lightning Storm, Ents go to War

1879500410.name: Gandalf's Aid
1879500410.desc: Call upon Gandlaf to bolster your Hope in the face of overwhelming despair.\n\nTo use this skill, you must be near Gandalf.

1879506682.name: Conviction
1879506682.desc: Call upon the eagle's conviction to restore the Morale of yourself or a fellow.

1879508602.name: Pale Deep-claw Whelp
1879508602.desc: Summons a pale deep-claw whelp to accompany you on your travels.

1879508730.name: Guide to Sul Madásh
1879508730.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Sul Madásh in Adagím in Mûr Ghala.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879520634.name: Toffee Mûrai Herding Dog
1879520634.desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879523194.name: The Effigy of The Gloom of Nurn
1879523194.desc: Summon an effigy of The Gloom of Nurn, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879524090.name: Fury of the Warlord
1879524090.desc: A demonstration of raw strength that deals massive damage to your enemies and saps their morale afterward.

1879527418.name: Jagged Metal Shard
1879527418.desc: Use the shard in a slashing attack, damaging the target and breaking Shield of Darkness. This power will also harm the user.
